diagnosis: The key management controller returns a DTO transformed by MapStruct where nested encryption key attributes (masterKeyHex) are copied from the persistence entity without an explicit ignore directive or tenant authorization check. An authenticated user can inspect raw cryptographic master keys and tenant wrapping seeds belonging to other customer organizations.
